_comment: Home-plate-through-pitcher's-mound-to-center-field compass bearing (0=N, 90=E, 180=S, 270=W) for MLB stadiums. Most entries were computed from real OpenStreetMap field geometry (mound centroid + outfield-wall polygon, cross-validated via two independent bisection methods agreeing within a few degrees). mlb-tex, mlb-tor, mlb-ari, mlb-mia, mlb-wsh, mlb-oak came from Derek directly (OSM geometry wasn't usable for these) — mlb-mia is a rounded 135 for a plain 'Southeast' value, less precise than the others. All 30 parks now covered.
